request.style: English, male baritone, deep and reflective, solo with soft piano, strings, and gentle guitar, somber and reverent, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Terah lived in Ur of Chaldees
Seventy years he walked the dust
He became the father of three sons
Abram, Nahor, and Haran he trusted

[Verse]
Haran became the father of Lot
Milcah and Iscah came from him
He died in the land of his birth
While his father Terah still lived

[Chorus]
Haran in Ur, where the family stayed
Before the journey to Canaan
His early death, a turning point
In the history of the patriarchs

[Verse]
Abram and Nahor took wives
Sarai was the wife of Abram
Milcah was the daughter of Haran
Who was the father of Milcah

[Chorus]
Haran in Ur, where the family stayed
Before the journey to Canaan
His early death, a turning point
In the history of the patriarchs

[Bridge]
The account of Terah is told
Haran became the father of Lot
He died in the land of his birth
In Ur of the Chaldeans

[Outro]
Haran in Ur, where the family stayed
Before the journey to Canaan
